acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
Xcalibur software (v.4.4.16.14) was used for the data acquisition and the instrument was operated in data-dependent mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Cleared supernatants were alkylated with 5mM iodoacetamide, and then precipitated with three volumes of a solution containing 50% acetone and 50% ethanol.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Cleared supernatants were alkylated with 5mM iodoacetamide, and then precipitated with three volumes of a solution containing 50% acetone and 50% ethanol.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were re-solubilized in 2 M urea, 50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, and 150 mM NaCl, and then digested with TPCK-treated trypsin (50:1) overnight at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: Selected ions were fragmented by collision-induced dissociation (CID) with normalized collision energies of 34 and the tandem mass spectra were acquired in the ion trap mass analyzer with the scan rate set to ‘Rapid’.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Selected ions were fragmented by collision-induced dissociation (CID) with normalized collision energies of 34 and the tandem mass spectra were acquired in the ion trap mass analyzer with the scan rate set to ‘Rapid’.

instrument.value: Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA)
instrument.evidence: TMT-labeled peptides were resuspended in 0.1% formic acid analyzed on a Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) equipped with a Thermo EASY-nLC 1200 LC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA).

labeling.evidence: For each sample, 25 µg of desalted peptide samples were resuspended in 20 µL of 100 mM Triethylammonium bicarbonate solution and labeled with 16-plex TMTpro at a ratio 4:1 (TMT:peptide).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Survey scans were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer (centroid mode) over the range 380–1,400 m/z with a mass resolution of 120,000 (at m/z 200).
